mapper.insert: INSERT INTO drug_dispense (prescription_id, patient_id, status, review_operator_id, review_comment, review_time, dispense_operator_id, dispense_time, create_time) VALUES (#{prescriptionId}, #{patientId}, #{status}, #{reviewOperatorId}, #{reviewComment}, #{reviewTime}, #{dispenseOperatorId}, #{dispenseTime}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM drug_dispense WHERE patient_id = #{patientId}
mapper.update: UPDATE drug_dispense SET status = #{status}, review_comment = #{reviewComment}, review_operator_id = #{reviewOperatorId}, review_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING_REVIEW'
UPDATE drug_dispense SET status = #{status}, dispense_operator_id = #{dispenseOperatorId}, dispense_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'REVIEW_PASSED'
